summary: EchoStar Corporation (EchoStar) filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a sale of assets and repayment of debt. On July 28, 2026, EchoStar and other seller parties completed the sale of 3.45 GHz and 600 MHz spectrum licenses to AT&T Mobility II LLC, a subsidiary of AT&T Inc., under a License Purchase Agreement dated August 25, 2025. EchoStar received $20.25 billion in proceeds, with an additional $2.4 billion deposited into an FCC trust. Concurrently, DISH DBS Corporation fully repaid $2.0 billion of its 7.75% Senior Notes due 2026, and DISH Network Corporation redeemed its $3.686 billion 11.75% Senior Secured Notes due 2027, including premiums. The transactions support deleveraging and were authorized by the bankruptcy court overseeing DISH DBS restructuring. Watch for FCC trust approval timeline and any regulatory conditions.
